ava: heads-up: after upgrading the demo SDK, the Cloudflare Worker preview fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: fs.
tom: that means bundler chose our node entry. Workers have no fs/Buffer or Node streams.
sara: yup — types also blow up because our d.ts references NodeJS.ReadableStream in a couple of exported interfaces.
frank: immediate workaround for demo: import the browser entry directly `@redwood/inference/dist/index.browser.mjs` and shim randomBytes using crypto.getRandomValues. ugly but fast.
ava: patched a tiny helper in the demo: `const rnd=(n)=>{const a=new Uint8Array(n);crypto.getRandomValues(a);return a}`. preview runs.
tom: long-term fixes: (1) add a browser/edge ESM entry (dist/index.browser.mjs), (2) exports map in package.json so bundlers pick it by default, (3) move node-only helpers behind dynamic import, (4) audit typings to avoid leaking Node types.
sara: I'll grep for Buffer|fs|NodeJS|ReadableStream and put a list in the issue. we should prefer WHATWG/Dom streams in public types.
frank: sample patch idea: runtime uses a small abstraction for randomness that prefers web crypto and dynamic imports crypto for node: `const isNode = typeof process !== 'undefined' && !!process.versions?.node; export const randomBytes = isNode ? async n => (await import('crypto')).randomBytes(n) : n => { const a=new Uint8Array(n); crypto.getRandomValues(a); return a; }`
tom: also check auth flow — we clone Requests and at one point convert bodies to Node streams. keep shared path DOM-first and only convert in node entry.
ava: action items: frank will draft v0.9.3 patch with exports map + gated node helpers + worker smoke test; sara will audit typings; tom will add bundler+dom-type CI job.
frank: will add a wrangler preview smoke test in CI and lint to prevent importing fs in client modules.
bot-ci: issue #1510 created: "edge/browser entry + typings audit" and attached demo PR.
ava: thanks — once patched i'll revert the demo shim. :rocket:
